about: WAVE-CASE-1: the wave names the wave editor and Set-VmfWavePlan refuse together. layout = the names of the waves to save; stored = the wave names of the plan as stored; clash = what both rules answer (null when the names are usable). kind same = two waves with one name; case = two waves whose names differ only in letter case; stored = a wave whose name differs only in letter case from a stored wave name. tests/js/wave-case.test.js runs findWaveNameClash (waves.js) against these cases, and tests/unit/WaveCase.Tests.ps1 runs Find-VmfWaveNameClash.

cases.why: a rename to a new name is usable
no wave at all is usable
two waves that differ only in letter case
letter case anywhere in the name counts
a rename that changes only the letter case of a stored wave
a new wave named as a stored wave in another letter case
a name that is exactly a stored wave name is that wave
the planner's own word for no wave is not a wave
no wave twice is not two waves
an empty stored name is not a wave
